items.briefing:
Australian edtech platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach, exposing personal information belonging to more than one million students, parents, and teachers. If you or your family members use Mathspace, be alert for phishing emails or suspicious contact using your personal details.

More broadly, AI is making scams increasingly convincing and harder to detect. Cybersecurity authorities are urging organisations to take AI-related risks seriously and act now rather than wait. If you receive an unexpected message — even one that seems very convincing — verify the sender through a separate, trusted channel before clicking links or sharing information.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
